21st annual · Paul, Idaho

Contact the team ↗
Can I walk the 5K?

Yes. Runners and walkers of all ages and abilities are welcome. Walkers should start toward the back of the field so faster participants can move safely.

Do children need their own registration?

Yes. Register each child individually so they have their own entry and waiver. Check current age categories and fees ↗ before signing up.

What does my entry include?

Your entry includes the 5K, race timing, finish-line treats, and a commemorative shirt while supplies last. Race-day shirts and timing chips are first come, first served.

When and where do I check in?

Check-in is from 8 to 9 AM on November 26, 2026, in the West Minico Middle School gym. The race starts at 9 AM Mountain on the school track.

Can I bring a dog or stroller?

These policies are not confirmed in the current 2026 information. Please ask the organizers ↗ before bringing a dog or stroller.

What should I wear?

Dress in layers for a chilly Idaho morning. Consider moisture-wicking clothing and bring a dry change of clothes. Contact the organizers for current weather or safety updates.
